  • In the provided code, there is no evidence of .pth, sitecustomize.py, usercustomize.py, install-time setup.py logic, PEP 517 build hooks, or malicious import-time side effects.
  • src/engine/cli.py defines Typer CLI commands (version, info, extract, normalize, conformity). These appear to be normal user-invoked console_scripts behavior and are not evidence of automatic execution.

Theft / Exfiltration / Persistence / Lateral Movement / Stealth

  • **Credential harvesting:** src/engine/cli.py references GEMINI_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY, and OPENROUTER_API_KEY, but this appears to be normal documented API-key handling for selected LLM providers. There is no evidence of broad environment-variable harvesting, .env scraping, SSH key discovery, cloud credential theft, or CI token collection.
  • **Exfiltration / staging:** https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 appears to be a normal LLM provider endpoint tied to the package’s documented functionality. zipfile usage aligns with .docx / WordprocessingML parsing and does not indicate archive staging of harvested files or upload behavior.
  • **Persistence:** No evidence of cron jobs, systemd units, launch agents, shell profile edits, startup persistence, or background polling loops.
  • **Lateral movement:** No evidence of Kubernetes service-account abuse, Docker socket access, cloud metadata access, GitHub Actions/PyPI/npm token reuse, or workflow injection.
  • **Obfuscation / loader:** The many re.compile occurrences appear to support document template, PII, and structural parsing features. There is no evidence of a base64/zlib/marshal/eval/exec staged loader or hidden obfuscated payload.
  • **raw.githubusercontent.com in documentation:** It appears only as a Ruff badge URL in README/PKG-INFO and is not tied to executable downloader or dropper behavior.

  • Dependencies appear related to document processing, CLI functionality, optional LLM providers, and development/testing extras, with no direct evidence tying them to malicious supply-chain activity.
